title: C0de's Dalek Mod PBR
description: PBR textures for Dalek Mod to allow better compatibility with shaders, hand crafted by The God of Artron.
body:
# **What is this?**
Pretty self explanatory. It's a resource pack to add PBR textures into Dalek Mod by SWD Team. I use shaders frequently, and felt like everything was a bit lacking without PBRs, so I just made some.
# **What versions of DM does this work with?**
The first version of this resource pack is made for DM U70.5, but I'll leave a list of the different versions of the pack and what versions of Dalek Mod they're made for.
- 0.0.1 | DM U70.5
# **Why isn't every texture here/finished?**
Making stuff takes a while, and I don't have a lot of time to make these, so it's going to take me a hot minute to finish every texture, but I will eventually.

# **What's Dalek Mod?**
Well you clearly have not played it yet, so, go check it out on [SWD Team's website](https://swdteam.com/p/dalek-mod), as well as all their other mods and projects!
